source: ENISA Space Threat Landscape 2025, Annex C Table 17 (via Phalanx/framework/enisa_threats_tuple.csv)
name: Negligence of asset handling security requirements
description: Threats stemming from irrational or improper behavior of actors involved in a satellites' lifecycle. These may include instances of, for example, non-conformity to security requirements during the design, configuration, and operation phases of software and/or hardware components, etc. which could be a source of vulnerabilities and open the doors for subsequent threats and attacks.
